premises.text: Cloud workloads land in energy-intensive data centers under rising media/AI demand and chip-cost pressure while billions of end devices sit idle
premises.evidence_span: It usually ends up in massive, energy-guzzling data centers that are often designed to maximize profits without much regard for the environment

premises.text: ByteKnight software harnesses everyday devices into a distributed grid for intensive tasks like video encoding, generative AI, and 3D rendering
premises.evidence_span: We are a software that harnesses the collective strength of everyday devices to tackle intensive tasks like video encoding, generative AI, and 3D rendering

premises.text: Device providers earn a majority revenue share up to a stated monthly amount per device
premises.evidence_span: We share 70% of the revenue, and we allow you to earn up to $150 per month for each device that you provide

premises.text: Customers get cost-effective computing that can accelerate workflows many times versus cloud
